Hong Kong’s efforts in advancing the city’s innovation and technology (I&T) industry have been highlighted in a number of international surveys in recent years.
One of the most recent was the International Institute for Management Development’s “World Competitiveness Ranking 2026”, which placed Hong Kong second among 70 economies worldwide.
